'''March 2001 Fitchburg Sealed Deck tournament (31 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed held in Magic Guild, Fitchburg, MA on 31 March 2001. It is known from Kris Earle's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2199">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-30-3-31-2001-joes-fitchburg-sealedd2199/ 3-31-2001-joes-fitchburg-sealed], DeckTech (Kris "Figgiedan" Earle, 30 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-30-3-31-2001-joes-fitchburg-sealedd2199/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 31 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Magic Guild, Fitchburg, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck (format)]]
